_comment: Vanilla End's final_density structure, Y-shifted to put islands at overworld Y=180-300, plus belt-and-braces air clamps so nothing solid generates outside that band. The post-gen handler (NetherFluidFix → BiomeColumnPostGen) sweeps the rest. Vanilla End at Y < 4 has density ~-0.234 (mostly air) which the air clamp reinforces; below Y=170 we force -30 to guarantee void. Above Y=310 the same. Inside Y=180-300, the vanilla shape with sloped_cheese / inner+outer gradients / squeeze / interpolated / blend_density produces authentic floating-island terrain — irregular bottoms (NOT flat cliffs), gappy tops, scattered sky islands. The Y values are shifted +176 (vanilla 4→180, 32→208, 56→232) and the upper decay is compressed (vanilla 312→300) so the band fits inside our overworld build height.

argument1._comment: Force void below Y=170: ramps from 0 above to -30 below. Stacks with vanilla End's natural -0.234 below the start Y to guarantee no terrain underneath.

argument2._comment: Force void above Y=310 — same idea above the island band.
